headline: Fronts Intensify; Bases Shift Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Since the 12:10 edition the war’s most volatile sectors have deepened their turmoil. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest theatre, logging 56 ownership changes in the last 24 hours and pushing Warden losses to 575 per hour, both sides accelerating. Stlican Shelf follows with 40 daily flips and two fresh changes in the past two hours, casualty rates climbing sharply for each faction. Godcrofts has erupted, recording 30 daily transitions and six new events in the last six hours, with casualties and enlistments surging. Stonecradle added 17 daily flips and three recent changes, its loss curves steepening. Callahan’s Passage, already a meat‑grinder, saw three fresh captures in the last two hours and casualties now rising above 650 per hour for each side. Marban Hollow likewise posted three new events in two hours and accelerating losses on both fronts. Meanwhile Viper Pit’s casualties have cooled and Fisherman’s Row shows no new two‑hour activity, suggesting a temporary lull there. The six fronts above dominate the tactical picture and are the likeliest sources of further base‑ownership shifts in the coming day.
